_comment: Copy to Channels_Data/hub.json. The hub creates this file itself from the first channel config it finds when it is missing. ChannelTemplate holds the keys a newly onboarded channel's config starts with; channel-specific keys (ChannelName, BrodcasterId, ApiPort, tokens) are filled in by the hub.
ApiPublicUrl: https://bot.example.com (public URL of the panel; OAuth redirect is {ApiPublicUrl}/api/auth/callback)
ApiClientId: client id of your Twitch application (required)
TApiClientSecret: client secret of your Twitch application (required)
RootUser: your_twitch_login (required; root on the hub and in every channel)
BotTwitchName: bot_login (the account the bot chats from; root authorizes it on the hub page)
